pc_changelog:
v2.9.0 — Sync fixes, category bar fix, Firebase cleanup

• Fixed Android sync race condition
• Accumulative sync — no more re-downloading old files
• Startup cleanup purges stale Firebase entries
• Fixed category bar text clipping in Files section
• Wallpaper frosted glass header refinement
android_changelog:
v2.9.1 — Remove Device Fix & Background Screenshot Sync

• Fixed: Removed paired devices still showing as 'Paired' on home screen
• Fixed: Screenshot detector now works when app is backgrounded (floating ball only)
• Native auto-upload: Screenshots sync to PC directly from foreground service
• Added missing native bridge methods (setPcUrl, setDeviceName, setClipboardSuppressed)
